Hi Jack — thanks for the clear list. Quick update / questions from our side: 

1) Coverage minimums: Redwood's standard public-hosted Order Form footprint meets the CGL and E&O limits you listed once the customer elects the enterprise tier. For the pilot Order Form we have a variance process; procurement typically accepts a COI plus a carrier endorsement in advance of production.

2) Additional insured + waiver: We typically can provide an Additional Insured endorsement naming Aurora Health Systems, Inc. The waiver of subrogation is more constrained — we need to confirm with our broker (Aon) on carrier acceptance for cyber policies specifically. Our legal team will confirm the language for both.

3) Timing: I'll send a sample COI and the endorsement wording by Monday. If Aurora needs the endorsement before countersignature we can push for an insurer-issued endorsement; otherwise a COI + written attestation from our broker can be provided to unblock signature. Which path do you prefer?

Looping in Aditya (legal) and Laura (operations) to confirm acceptable wording and timing.

Next steps / asks for Aurora: if procurement can indicate whether a broker attestation is acceptable for go-live (and the timeframe for the endorsement), that will determine whether we need to escalate with the carrier.
